name: Advanced User Role Manager
author: Smackcoders Inc.,

sections.description:
Advanced User Role Manager is a comprehensive solution for managing WordPress user roles and capabilities, crafted by experienced human developers. This plugin extends WordPress’s default role system with advanced features for better user access control, designed with real-world use cases in mind.

Key Features:

  • Custom Role Management: Create, edit, clone, and delete custom user roles
  • Temporary Role Assignments: Assign roles with automatic expiration
  • Granular Capability Control: Manage specific permissions for each role
  • OAuth2 Integration: Secure login with external providers
  • Role-Based User Filtering: Filter and manage users by their roles
  • Audit Logging: Track all role-related changes for security
  • Multi-Role Support: Assign multiple roles to individual users

Use Cases:

  • Membership sites requiring different access levels
  • Multi-author blogs with varying permissions
  • E-commerce sites with customer and staff roles
  • Corporate websites with role-based access control
  • Educational platforms with student and teacher roles

Compatibility:

  • Works with WooCommerce and other e-commerce plugins
  • Compatible with membership plugins
  • Supports custom post types
  • Built following WordPress coding standards
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/advanced-user-role-manager/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress admin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Advanced User Role Manager menu to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Can I assign multiple roles to a single user?

Yes, the plugin supports assigning multiple roles to individual users.

Can roles be set to expire automatically?

Yes, temporary roles can be assigned with automatic expiration dates.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, it’s fully compatible with WooCommerce and supports WooCommerce-specific roles.

Does the OAuth2 integration require coding knowledge?

No, the OAuth2 setup is handled through the admin interface with step-by-step guidance.

Will this conflict with other role management plugins?

It’s recommended to use only one role management plugin at a time to avoid conflicts.

Is there an audit trail for role changes?

Yes, all role and capability changes are logged with user and timestamp information.
